essence: After completing all oblation rites, one should invoke Gaṅgā.
The invoked Gaṅgā is an age-established water stream that destroys all diseases.
Sages and others should be honored as before using the specified numerical measure.
One accomplished in the mantra should perform the oblation procedures as before.
Abundant rain occurs after three days even in the non-rainy season.
